question: What is the most money you have ever found, and what did you do with it?
story: I found four thousand dollars hidden inside a used couch, and trying to give it back almost got me arrested. The couch came from an estate sale. Ninety dollars, ugly plaid, one broken leg. When I flipped it over to fix the leg, there was a slit in the lining with a bank envelope taped inside. Four thousand and sixty dollars, all twenties, rubber banded by year. I could have kept it. Nobody would have known. I called the estate company instead. They gave me a name, the name led to a daughter in another state, and she told me flatly that her father never hid money and that I was running a scam. Then she reported me. To the police. I spent two months explaining a couch to a detective. In March, she called back. She had found his notebook. Every deposit was written down, going back to nineteen eighty eight. She let me keep half.
